pr_body:
This PR introduces a check to prevent upgrading to 8.0 without first upgrading to 7.last.

Closes #81865
pr_comments: Hi @grcevski, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Thanks for the review @DaveCTurner! I think I applied all suggestions.

issue_context.title: Unsupported upgrades from 7.nonlast to 8.x are still permitted
issue_context.body:
Upgrading to the next major version with a rolling restart requires upgrading to the last minor of the previous major first. However you could upgrade from 5.x to 6.x and from 6.x to 7.x via a full cluster restart without upgrading to 5.last (respectively 6.last) first.

For 8.x we will impose the same restriction on both upgrade paths: they must always go via 7.last. This will ensure that folks are notified about all deprecations and other changes before starting the major upgrade.

We should prevent users from inadvertently doing an unsupported upgrade from 7.15 or earlier to 8.x by bailing out if the on-disk node version is too old. It should be ok to let users explicitly bypass this restriction by running `elasticsearch-node override-version`, but we want this to be an explicit action with a disclaimer and an acknowledgement from the user, rather than something that just silently appears to work.

/cc @skearns64 

Relates #81862

review_comments: I think this is the only test that asserts that `previousNodeVersion` works, so we should keep it around.
For this test we should adjust the definition of `tooOldVersion` so that it uses `minimumCompatibilityVersion` instead of `minimumIndexCompatibilityVersion`.
Could we `assert nodeVersion.equals(Version.V_EMPTY) == false` to ensure that we're right to drop this branch?

We have a test that tests this explicitly - testUpgradesMissingVersion, we throw the same version exception as if the version was 7.nonlast, since V_EMPTY resolves to 0. 

I can swap the test with the assert, but I think the test is a stronger validation that we'll fail to start with <= 6.latest metadata, where version is empty as per the previous assert.

I think I'll introduce an assert like the one we had before, ensuring that Version can only be empty if we are older than 7.0 + 1.
